notes: You cannot apply in earlier grades. Students should not plan another job or internship during the four weeks. Students outside the US are not eligible.
name: MIT Women's Technology Program (WTP-ME)
what_you_do: Four-week residential summer program at MIT on the Mechanical Engineering track. Housing and food are in MIT dorms. Open to students with little or no engineering experience.
who_can_apply: Students now in 11th grade with a permanent family address in the US and little or no engineering experience. About 20 spots, and the page says it generally gets over 300 applications. Students should not have completed WTP curriculum coursework or WTP summer programs.
pay_detail: Free to apply. Free to attend if family income is $120,000 or less. Otherwise $2,000 ($120,000 to $150,000), $4,000, $8,000 or $20,000 by income. Housing and food included. More aid may be asked for.
deadline_text: Application opens Oct 16 in SlideRoom (the page says summer 2027 and does not print the year). Deadline Dec 21. Teacher forms due Dec 23, and late forms are accepted until Jan 20 but delay decisions. Decisions by email mid to late March. Admitted students confirm in early April.
how_to_apply: Online SlideRoom application: three personal essays, and online forms from one math teacher and one science teacher.
